title: Su Qingyao's Question
next_chapter_hook: In the instant that gaze vanished, Chen Ji suddenly sensed a familiar aura—that unique scent clinging to Ling Yuan, ancient and rotting, yet carrying a terrifying pressure.

text.content: The night wind rose abruptly, dispersing the bloodstained token's scent across the courtyard. Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing's slowly solidifying form, yet his face betrayed not a trace of panic. He gently placed the final black piece onto the chessboard, producing a crisp sound. "Since the Saint Maiden desires answers," he raised his head, eyes deep as an abyss, "perhaps she should first hear another person's questioning." Before his words even faded, hurried footsteps echoed from the courtyard's depths, accompanied by a low hiss of suppressed fury—"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's figure flashed through the moon gate, white robes billowing, frost dense upon her countenance.

dialogue.content: "Faking death to escape, venturing alone into the forbidden grounds, arranging things in secret—Chen Ji, what do you take me, Su Qingyao, for?" Her voice reverberated through the night wind, the suppressed fury making even the surrounding air feel heavy. "Was there ever a place for me in your plans?"

text.content: At the sight of this, Ye Qing's smile deepened, and she casually stepped back, assuming the posture of an onlooker. Chen Ji, however, acted as if she didn't exist—all his attention was captured by Su Qingyao's reddened eyes. He knew that this stubborn woman, the angrier she became, the more she suffered. She never shed tears before others, yet tonight she had broken that rule. Moonlight fell upon her, illuminating those slightly trembling shoulders as being impossibly frail.

dialogue.content: "Qingyao," he began, his voice carrying an unfamiliar hoarseness, "sit and let's talk." Su Qingyao refused to yield a single step, closing in until she stood directly before him, nearly biting out the question: "Talk about what? About how you kept me in the dark? About how you walked alone toward death without even a word of explanation?"

text.content: The night wind stirred fallen leaves, circling once between the three of them. Chen Ji lowered his gaze, and for the first time on that perpetually calm face, exhaustion and struggle appeared. His fingers unconsciously rubbed against his sleeve cuff, where the cool touch of the Tianji Record Fragment lay hidden. "Because I know," he finally spoke, his voice so low it was barely audible, "that if I told any of you, someone would be forced to gamble their life alongside mine."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's entire body shuddered. Within those furious eyes, a disbelieving glint suddenly flickered. She opened her mouth, only to find all her questions had lodged themselves in her throat. Beneath the moonlight, she saw Chen Ji raise his head—and within those customarily unfathomable eyes, there was something she had never witnessed before: vulnerability.

text.content: "I've watched too many people fall beside me," Chen Ji's voice was soft, as if speaking to himself. "Every person who tried to help me ended up as a discarded piece on the chessboard. I don't want—" His words suddenly stopped, his Adam's apple bobbing slightly, as if repressing something with great effort. The night deepened; the courtyard fell so silent one could only hear the three people's barely perceptible breathing.

choice.prompt: Facing Su Qingyao's questioning, Chen Ji must make a choice—reveal everything or continue concealing the truth to protect her?

choices.description: Reveal the complete truth of the fake death plan to Su Qingyao, only hiding core secrets like the Tianji Record and Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Loss of Partial Control Over the Plan
choices.risk_hint: She May Fall Into Danger Due to Knowing Too Much

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao listened quietly as Chen Ji explained his arrangements. The anger on her face gradually faded, replaced by a complex, indescribable expression. When he finished, she was silent for a long moment before softly saying: "So you've been carrying all of this alone?"

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer, but that silence itself was the answer. Su Qingyao suddenly stepped forward and grasped his wrist—the hand trembled slightly, yet held with tremendous strength. Beneath the moonlight, her eyes were red-rimmed, but she stubbornly refused to let tears fall.

choices.description: Use half-truths to evade Su Qingyao, insisting everything was done to protect everyone, revealing none of the true dangers.

dialogue.content: "'Protect everyone?'" Su Qingyao laughed coldly, though the light in her eyes dimmed somewhat. "Chen Ji, when did you learn to speak such flowery, empty words?" Her fingers tightened slightly, her voice carrying an imperceptible tremor.

text.content: Chen Ji watched her expression shift, and his heart ached faintly, yet he could only press that guilt deep within. He knew—the more he said, the greater the risk of exposure. The night wind swept past, scattering Su Qingyao's hair and blowing away her final trace of hope.

Watching this scene from the side, a playful glint flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, but she offered no interruption. She suddenly felt that this seemingly cold and ruthless waste disciple, at this moment, cast a somewhat... solitary silhouette. After a moment, she sighed softly, her form gradually fading, leaving this space to those two alone.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji," Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice light yet carrying an unprecedented resolve. "Do you know why I must ask these questions?" Chen Ji raised his head, meeting those eyes brimming with glistening light. She spoke word by word: "Because I no longer wish to remain an outsider."

text.content: Moonlight poured down, stretching their two figures long and close together. Chen Ji gazed at her, seeing within those eyes a burning radiance—not anger, but something that alarmed him even more than anger. Almost instinctively, he said: "Qingyao, you don't understand what that means—"

dialogue.content: "I do," she cut him off, her voice carrying a thread of resolve. "Gambling my life alongside yours, correct?" Chen Ji's entire body shuddered. She met his gaze, the corner of her lips lifting slightly—that smile held heartache, helplessness, but above all, a resolute determination to cast aside all caution. "Then let's gamble together."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's determination left Chen Ji in a dilemma—accept her proposal to stand together, or continue keeping her beyond the circle of danger?

choices.description: Agree to share destiny with Su Qingyao, sealing a生死相依 oath beneath the moonlight.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Possibility of Su Qingyao's 'Shared Fate' Contract
choices.risk_hint: Her Safety Is Now Bound to Yours

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at her for a long while before finally letting out a soft sigh. He raised his hand, fingertips touching hers, sketching a silent contract beneath the moonlight. "Alright," he murmured, "together, step for step." Three words, yet they carried the weight of a thousand tons.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes finally reddened, yet she defiantly lifted her chin, refusing to let tears fall. She whispered: "This is what you owe me." The night breeze brushed past, scattering these words between them, dissolving the final barrier between them.

choices.description: Reject Su Qingyao's proposal, claiming the danger is too great, unwilling to involve her.

dialogue.content: "No." Chen Ji shook his head, his voice carrying undeniable resolve. "This path is too dangerous. I cannot let you—" "Cannot let me what?" Su Qingyao interrupted him once more, a wounded glint flickering in her eyes. "Cannot let me help you? Cannot let me accompany you?"

text.content: Her voice carried a tremor, yet she forced herself not to cry. Beneath the moonlight, her silhouette appeared so fragile and stubborn. Chen Ji saw this, and something in his heart felt as if it were being cruelly gripped. The night wind suddenly stilled; the courtyard plunged into dead silence.

After a long moment, Chen Ji finally relented. He extended his hand, gently grasping Su Qingyao's cool fingers. The warmth of his palm transmitted through skin; he felt her trembling, and beneath that trembling, the resolve she concealed. "Alright," he murmured, "together, step for step." Moonlight flowed like water, cascading over their intertwined hands—a kind of ancient witness.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes reddened, yet beneath the moonlight she offered a relieved smile. She whispered: "Remember what was said tonight, Chen Ji. Whatever happens, I will not let you face it alone." With that, she released his hand, turned, and walked toward the moon gate. Her footsteps faded into the distance, yet paused before vanishing completely—"Also," her voice drifted back on the wind, "if you dare keep secrets from me again, the questioning will be the least of your concerns."

text.content: Chen Ji watched her silhouette vanish beyond the moon gate, the corners of his lips lifting slightly—a genuine smile, devoid of any calculation. The night wind brushed past once more, bringing a hint of chill—and with it, a perception that sent a cold shiver down his spine. He suddenly froze, his gaze shooting like lightning toward the shadows in the courtyard's corner. Something had flickered there. Was it just an illusion? Chen Ji's brow furrowed, yet he saw nothing. But his instinct told him—from earlier until now, there had been a pair of eyes watching his every move from the darkness.
